attributes.title: CPS 2027 Winter Meeting
attributes.venue: The Westin Riverfront Resort and Spa
attributes.cme_provider: University of Colorado Skaggs School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences
attributes.summary:
The Colorado Pharmacists Society's 2027 Winter Meeting, themed Fresh Tracks in Pharmacy, runs January 30 to February 2, 2027, at The Westin Riverfront Resort and Spa in Avon, at the base of Beaver Creek. The program for pharmacists, students and technicians is scheduled around skiing and other winter activities, with an exhibit hall evening with industry vendors. Full-conference registration and day passes are available.

CPE is provided by the University of Colorado Skaggs School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences, an ACPE-accredited provider; CPS notes the conference is still pending accreditation, so the number of hours is not published yet. Early-bird pricing ends November 2, 2026. Group rooms at the Westin start at $429 per night plus taxes and fees and must be booked by December 29, 2026.
